context:
Goal: in a coordinator build, each session does only its own tier's work.
Problem (rule): two records disagree. standing-merge-grant says the coordinator merges and uses its own agents to build, review and batch; session-tiers gives merges to the batch runner and says the coordinator holds only lane state.
Based on (read): standing-merge-grant and session-tiers on main.
Based on (ruling): your words Oct 31 15:31 CDT: sessions keep to their tier.
Departs from: standing-merge-grant (the coordinator merges and runs agents) — a: in a coordinator build the batch runner merges; solo and one-lane sessions keep merging their own work as today.

This question is only about a coordinator build. A solo or one-lane session merges its own pull request as it does today, under the repo's grant.

lastAnswer.note: a repo merges only while a batch runners up makes no sense because remember there can be solo sessions that do work and handle a merge i dislike the way you expresesd the fault in A

options.gain: The tiers match what you asked for on Oct 31.
options.how: The coordinator runs no build or review agents and merges nothing; its batch runner merges in each repo it covers. standing-merge-grant is rewritten to match. Solo and one-lane sessions are unchanged.
options.label: In a coordinator build, the batch runner merges
options.lose: When a coordinator build has no batch runner running, the coordinator starts one before anything merges.

options.gain: No change to how merges run.
options.how: The coordinator keeps merging and running agents, and session-tiers is rewritten to match.
options.label: Keep the coordinator merging
options.lose: What you complained about on Oct 31 stays allowed.

ref: tier-boundaries-enforced (sessions keep to their tier); decisions standing-merge-grant and session-tiers
title: Does only the batch runner merge, with no review agents in the coordinator?
why: Your pick, Nov 1 11:53 CST. Filed on roadmap step tier-boundaries-enforced; the lane took it into scope at 11:55 CST.
